boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented SUNY Maritime customs, ceremonies, and recurring seafaring practices, from cadet induction to Homecoming rites.

cards.title: INDOC
cards.subtitle: Regiment of Cadets initiation
cards.notes: Follow the college’s published INDOC guidance before arrival; it introduces new cadets to campus rules, shipboard skills, and the regimental routine.
cards.short_summary: The structured entry program for new members of the Regiment of Cadets.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says new Regiment members participate in INDOC, where they learn cadet rules, daily campus and shipboard knowledge, and train with cadet leaders and officers.
cards.access_notes: For incoming Regiment members; the college publishes annual reporting and preparation guidance.

cards.title: The MUG Recognition Ceremony
cards.subtitle: The conclusion of INDOC
cards.notes: If attending as a guest, confirm the annual date with the Regiment. The college identifies this ceremony as the formal conclusion of INDOC.
cards.short_summary: A formal recognition marking the end of the Mariner Under Guidance period.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime states that INDOC concludes with a MUG recognition ceremony and lists the 2026 ceremony for August 22, with no tickets required.
cards.access_notes: The college listed no tickets required for the 2026 ceremony; verify future dates before visiting.

cards.title: Summer Sea Term
cards.subtitle: Aboard Training Ship Empire State VII
cards.notes: Watch the college’s Sea Term updates to follow the training ship. Cadets apply coursework through watchstanding, maintenance, and emergency drills.
cards.short_summary: The recurring at-sea training term central to Maritime’s license-track cadet experience.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime describes Summer Sea Term as a pivotal cadet experience aboard Empire State VII after the freshman, sophomore, and junior years; SUNY called it a proud and unique tradition in 2026.
cards.source_title: Summer Sea Term | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: For cadets pursuing U.S. Coast Guard licenses; schedules and travel vary by year.

cards.title: Row Into the Monomoy Race
cards.subtitle: SUNY Maritime waterfront
cards.notes: Attend as a spectator from designated campus areas and follow event instructions. The college characterizes the Monomoy Race as time-honored.
cards.short_summary: A recurring collegiate rowing race rooted in the school’s waterfront culture.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s 2025 INDOC news calls the Monomoy Race “time-honored” and says cadets prepare to row into tradition.
cards.source_title: Welcome to INDOC 2025! | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Check the college’s event information for the current race date and spectator arrangements.

cards.title: Pass in Review
cards.subtitle: Homecoming & Reunion ceremony
cards.notes: Look for the ceremony on the Homecoming schedule and observe from the designated audience area. It is one of the college’s listed shared traditions.
cards.short_summary: A formal Homecoming review ceremony connecting the Regiment and alumni community.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime lists Pass in Review among its shared traditions and schedules a Pass in Review Ceremony during Homecoming 2026.
cards.source_title: Events for Alumni & Friends | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Homecoming; verify the current program and any attendance details.

cards.title: Heritage Hall Induction
cards.subtitle: Homecoming & Reunion ceremony
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming program for inductee announcements and ceremony timing. This is paired with Pass in Review in the college’s current schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming recognition ceremony honoring Maritime’s institutional heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime lists Heritage Hall among its shared traditions and schedules a Heritage Hall Induction during Homecoming 2026.
cards.source_title: Events for Alumni & Friends | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Homecoming; confirm the current program before attending.

cards.title: The Ancient Mariner Golf Outing
cards.subtitle: Homecoming’s Friday start
cards.notes: Register through the alumni event program if you plan to play. The outing opens Homecoming weekend before campus-based events begin.
cards.short_summary: An annual alumni golf gathering that traditionally starts Homecoming weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s Winter 2026 alumni magazine describes the annual Ancient Mariner Golf Outing as the traditional start to Homecoming weekend and announces its 2026 date.
cards.access_notes: The college schedules it for October 23, 2026 at Pelham Bay/Split Rock; registration and fees apply.

cards.title: “Will It Float” Race
cards.subtitle: Homecoming at McMurray Hall
cards.notes: Check Homecoming updates for rules and viewing details. The scheduled race has a specific campus venue, so use the official program on the day.
cards.short_summary: A named Homecoming race with a deliberately nautical premise.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s 2026 Homecoming schedule lists the “Will It Float” Race at McMurray Hall on Friday, October 23.
cards.source_title: Events for Alumni & Friends | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for October 23, 2026; verify event rules, timing, and audience access.

cards.title: The Regimental March On
cards.subtitle: Homecoming review tradition
cards.notes: Consult the current Homecoming program for the parade route and viewing location. Historical college programming places the March On with Pass in Review.
cards.short_summary: A formal regimental appearance incorporated into Maritime Homecoming programming.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s Homecoming publication lists “Pass in Review and Regimental March On” as part of its 2014 Homecoming program.
cards.access_notes: Historical documentation; verify whether it appears in the current Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: The Regiment of Cadets
cards.subtitle: SUNY Maritime since 1874
cards.notes: Learn about the optional regimental path before choosing it; it emphasizes leadership, discipline, and preparation for life aboard merchant vessels.
cards.short_summary: The long-running cadet lifestyle that anchors Maritime’s distinctive institutional culture.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says the Regiment of Cadets has offered its shipboard-preparation lifestyle since 1874 and is one of the college’s oldest traditions.
cards.source_title: Chart Your Course | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Participation is optional for many students but required for students pursuing U.S. Coast Guard licensure.
